description: Path-ownership map consumed by .claude/runtime/policy-engine.mjs to enforce writer isolation (.claude/rules/agent-orchestration.md: 'never allow two agents to write the same file concurrently'; .claude/rules/scope-control.md: 'each writer owns a bounded path set'). An agent whose tools include Edit/Write is only authorized to write paths matching an entry naming it.

owners.note: default writer for the bounded batch it's given; scope is further narrowed per-batch by mission-orchestrator, not by this file alone
via ops.mjs only, never direct file edits to product code
read-only by contract; any write attempt is a policy violation
read-only; hands missing-coverage findings to implementation-engineer
may create/update per-project stack rule files and the project manifest; may NOT touch generic pack rules already present
writes only via ops.mjs (requirement/criterion add), never direct file edits
read-only; containment itself is delegated to implementation-engineer
read-only against production; never a write action against a live environment
test files/fixtures only, never product source
only against an existing recovery-plan record; anything DESTRUCTIVE/EXTERNAL_WRITE/PRODUCTION_WRITE additionally requires a GRANTED approval-request

conflictRule: Two agents claiming write authority over an overlapping path for the same batch is a CONFLICT (.claude/contracts/conflict-record.schema.json) resolved by mission-orchestrator before either proceeds, never by last-write-wins.
